title: Faucet stroke deletion scope too broad: click on one of two crossing lines deletes BOTH whole lines; connectivity ignores stroke style
description: FIXED. connectedStrokeRun (planar/eraser.ts) rewritten from a flood-fill over ALL stroked edges sharing a vertex into a chain-walk that follows the clicked LINE: at a corner (degree-2 vertex) the single same-style continuation is always taken (rectangle outline still deletes in one click); at a crossing/junction (degree>2) only the geometric continuation within 45deg of straight-through is taken, so an unrelated crossing line survives; a lineStyle-index boundary is never crossed. Pick tolerance now zoom-adjusted (3/zoom from StageArea; faucetEraseShape gained a tol param). LINE-SCOPE DECISION (task marked needs-oracle-verification): implemented 'connected same-style run through corners, NOT through crossings, never across style changes' — the most Flash-faithful reading consistent with the documented rectangle-outline-one-click workflow; exact inter-intersection segment scope unconfirmed against a live Flash 8 oracle. Build: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0. Tests: @flash/core 356 files / 5831 pass (2 skip); @flash/authoring-ui 118 files / 1311 pass. New tests in planar-eraser.test.ts: crossing lines faucet leaves the other; black-touching-red leaves red; faucet on a fill deletes only that contiguous fill (disjoint same-color rect survives).
